shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
rg -n '\"(test|format|prettier)' package.json
sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Test extra tool input pass-through" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
